title: Topology-Aware Differential Privacy in Hierarchical Federated Learning
abstract: arXiv:2506.19260v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Hierarchical federated learning places regional aggregators between clients and the cloud, so a participant's update is observed only alongside its neighbours'. The concealment this arrangement provides depends on the size of the aggregation region, and regions in operational deployments vary widely. Prevailing practice applies a single noise multiplier to every participant, calibrated for the most exposed region, so every other participant carries more noise than its own exposure requires. We show that this allocation problem admits an explicit solution. We first give a silo-level differential privacy guarantee for the mechanism, then bound the mutual information between a participant's local class distribution and any estimate an observer positioned above the regional tier could form of it, using an adjacency notion matched to the quantity being protected. translated_title: 分层联邦学习中的拓扑感知差分隐私
translated_abstract: 分层联邦学习在客户端与云端之间放置区域聚合器，因此参与者的更新仅与其邻居的更新一起被观察到。这种安排所提供的隐蔽性取决于聚合区域的大小，而在实际部署中区域大小差异很大。现行做法是对每个参与者应用单一噪声乘数，该乘数根据暴露最严重的区域进行校准，导致其他所有参与者携带的噪声超过了其自身暴露所需的量。我们证明这一分配问题存在显式解。我们首先为该机制给出筒仓级差分隐私保证，然后使用与所保护量匹配的邻接概念，界定参与者本地类别分布与位于区域层级之上的观察者可能形成的任何估计之间的互信息。在固定效用预算下最小化最坏情况界限，得出了一种最优噪声分配方案。
tldr: 本文提出一种拓扑感知的噪声分配方法，通过显式解优化分层联邦学习中的差分隐私，在固定效用预算下最小化最坏情况隐私风险。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a topology-aware noise allocation method that explicitly optimizes differential privacy in hierarchical federated learning, minimizing worst-case privacy risk under a fixed utility budget.
